subject: Multi-region data residency & architecture review — scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-region data residency & architecture review — scheduling

Hi Sophie / Peter,

Thanks again for the time last week — great conversation. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive to walk through a multi-region deployment and data residency architecture (EU/US/APAC) tailored to Acme Bank's compliance requirements. The goal is to review:

- region-based data segregation and control plane models
- options for private deployment (VPC / on-prem) vs hosted with data routing
- KMS/HSM integration and audit logging expectations
- failover and latency trade-offs across regions

Suggested attendees from our side: Vivek (solutions), Neha (security/compliance), Marcus (platform). Could you confirm who from Acme should join (security, cloud infra, app owners)?

Below are some tentative slots (ET / CET):
- Wed 25 Feb: 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET
- Thu 26 Feb: 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET
- Fri 27 Feb: 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET

If none of those work, happy to take a few alternatives — we can also split into two shorter sessions if separate compliance and infra tracks are preferred.

I've attached a short architecture overview that we can use as a base for the discussion.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_multi-region-arch-overview.pdf

- Primary concerns: EU data residency for EU customers, key separation, and audit retention for 7+ years.
